newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Four Dublin prison officers held hostage.
newsitem.headline: Four Dublin prison officers held hostage.

text.p: Prisoners armed with makeshift weapons took four prison officers hostage in Dublin's Mountjoy Prison on Saturday night, officials said.
The convicts, whose weapons included iron bars and a blood-filled syringe, were demanding a move from the prison's segregation unit.

Six prison officers were originally taken hostage. But two were later freed, one being sent to the prison governor to ask Justice Department officials to intervene. None of the four remaining hostages were thought to be injured.
One of the prisoners involved in the protest is believed to be Paul Ward, facing conspiracy-to-murder charges in connection with the fatal shooting of investigative crime journalist Veronica Guerin.
The Victorian prison has long suffered from severe overcrowding and drug-taking.
